check: describe command('grep -rqE \'timestamp_timeout[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*-1\' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/ 2>/dev/null && echo ko || echo ok') do

remediation.command:
grep -rl 'timestamp_timeout[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*-1' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/ 2>/dev/null
# remove the 'timestamp_timeout=-1' line from each with visudo (default is 15min re-auth)
remediation.reason: sudoers edits risk lockout, always edit via visudo

title.en: Require Re-Authentication When Using the sudo Command
title.fr: Require Re-Authentication When Using the sudo Command

rationale.en: Without re-authentication, users may access resources or perform tasks for which they do not have authorization. When operating systems provide the capability to escalate a functional capability, it is critical that the user re-authenticate.
rationale.fr: Without re-authentication, users may access resources or perform tasks for which they do not have authorization. When operating systems provide the capability to escalate a functional capability, it is critical that the user re-authenticate.
